name: brdcomp-button-group
title: Button Group
description: A group of toggle buttons that supports single or multiple selection behavior. Works well for timeframe selectors.

examples.title: Button group options
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/button-group"

<ButtonGroup type="single" value="left">
  <ButtonGroupItem value="left">Left</ButtonGroupItem>
  <ButtonGroupItem value="right">Right</ButtonGroupItem>
</ButtonGroup>
